mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate above 7.0% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals a supply shock regime, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS > 0.5% month-over-month) indicates a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved consumer spending and corporate profits.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% within the past month signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate a severe demand collapse, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL < 215.0), a decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals accommodative policy without inflationary pressure, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 215.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.
